scope: Proposition 3.1 (Weighted graph criterion) of the manuscript “Lipschitz Equivalent Separable Banach Spaces Need Not Be Linearly Isomorphic” (preprints/Lipschitz-Equivalent-Separable-Banach-Spaces-Need-Not-Be-Linearly-Isomorphic-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 324 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cc670229303a1ed9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let U be a separable real Hilbert space, V = ℓ2, and M = U ⊕2 V , with projections πU , πV . Suppose h : M → U is a bijection with h(0) = 0 and, for all x, x′ ∈ M, a∥x − x′ ∥ ≤ ∥h(x) − h(x′ )∥ ≤ b∥x − x′ ∥, 0 < a ≤ b < ∞. Let E = F(M) and let q : E → U be the linearization of D = h − πU . Suppose q is completely continuous. Give E ⊕ V the sum norm, define Q1 : E ⊕1 V → M, Q1(e, v) = (qe, v), X = ZQ1 , Y = Zq, and put Lq = ∥q∥, Kq = max{Lq, 1}. Then X, Y are separable real Banach spaces and there is a bijection Ψ : X → Y such that Lip(Ψ) ≤ max{1 + Kq, b}, Lip(Ψ−1 ) ≤ max{1 + 2Lq/a, 1/a}. (3.1) Moreover, X contains c0(V ) isometrically and Y contains no closed subspace linearly isomor- phic to c0(V ).
